name: Test Observation Demo: Late Fees
description: Checks harvested Python and Rust test observations against a wrong and an aligned late-fee contract.

intro: Step 1: Copy the late-fee project and harvest its Python and Rust test observations.
Step 2: Check a deliberately wrong contract, then compare the aligned spec and .mm atom.
narrative.before: The wrong late-fee contract admits rejected inputs and predicts the wrong example result.
narrative.after: The aligned contract explains the rejected inputs and agrees with the examples and relation in both languages.

rejected.headline: observe-tests: harvested tests reject the wrong late-fee contract
follow_up: The example contradicts ensures and requires admits a rejected input.
The evidence is tied to the Python and Rust test cases.

pass.headline: observe-tests: the aligned late-fee spec matches the harvested tests
mumei observe: the .mm contract matches the harvested tests

harness_contract.intent: Show that deterministic test observations expose a wrong contract and confirm an aligned contract across Python, Rust, and mumei.
artifact_contracts: The first step copies scenarios/test_observation_demo/project into {output_dir}/project; commands use only that copy.
harvest_tests writes six observations: one example, relation, and rejection from each of Python and Rust.
observe_wrong exits 1 and the checked report ties both required verdicts to the expected Python test cases.
observe_aligned exits 0 with four consistent observations and two rejection_explained observations.
mumei_observe verifies aligned.mm and reports the same verdict totals as observe_aligned.
result.json, harness_state.json, and report.md record per-step observation verdicts and contradictions.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: A contract should reflect both observed results and observed rejected inputs, rather than merely verify for a narrow implementation.
success_criteria: The copied project yields one example, relation, and rejection observation for each language.
The wrong spec is rejected for the example and for admitting the rejected negative input.
The aligned spec is consistent with examples and relations and explains the rejected inputs.
The verified .mm atom produces the same observation verdict totals as the aligned spec.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Low: fixture inputs and expected verdicts are fixed, and every observation report is schema-checked and tied to its test case.

steps.name: Copy the late-fee fixture project
artifact_contract: The fixture project is copied to {output_dir}/project before commands run.

steps.name: Harvest Python and Rust test observations
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent harvest-tests {output_dir}/project/test_late_fee.py {output_dir}/project/late_fee.py {output_dir}/project/late_fee.rs --output {output_dir}/harvest.json && python3 -c 'import collections,json,pathlib,sys; data=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8")); observations=data.get("observations", []); languages={".py":"python", ".rs":"rust"}; counts=collections.Counter((languages.get(pathlib.Path(item.get("file", "")).suffix), item.get("kind")) for item in observations if isinstance(item, dict)); expected=collections.Counter({("python", "example"):1, ("python", "relation"):1, ("python", "rejects"):1, ("rust", "example"):1, ("rust", "relation"):1, ("rust", "rejects"):1}); summary=",".join(f"{language}:{kind}={counts[(language, kind)]}" for language in ("python", "rust") for kind in ("example", "relation", "rejects")); print(f"HARVEST_COUNTS total={len(observations)} {summary}"); sys.exit(0 if counts == expected and len(observations) == 6 else 1)' {output_dir}/harvest.json
artifact_contract: harvest-tests writes {output_dir}/harvest.json from the copied Python test, Python library, and Rust source.
The report contains one example, relation, and rejection from each language.
steps.verifier_gate: Harvest exits 0 and the report has exactly six observations with the pinned per-language counts.

steps.name: Reject the wrong spec against test observations
artifact_contract: observe-tests writes a mumei.observation-check/v1 report for the wrong spec.
The Python and Rust example and rejection test records carry the expected contradiction verdicts.
steps.verifier_gate: observe-tests exits 1; the report contains the expected example and rejected-input verdicts with pinned totals.

steps.name: Check the aligned spec against test observations
artifact_contract: observe-tests writes a report with no contradiction or admitted-rejection verdicts.
steps.verifier_gate: observe-tests exits 0 with four consistent results and two rejection_explained results.

steps.name: Verify the aligned .mm atom
artifact_contract: mumei verifies the aligned late_fee atom from the copied project.

steps.name: Check the aligned .mm atom against harvested observations
artifact_contract: mumei observe writes {output_dir}/observe_mm.json from harvest.json without contradictions.
The report verdict totals equal observe_aligned.json.
steps.verifier_gate: mumei observe exits 0 and has the same verdict totals as the aligned spec check.
